global.notes: Every setting, as a flat YAML map (yaml-cpp emitter, document markers --- and ...). Read once at process start (init_config), which then immediately rewrites the file from memory; also rewritten on every settings Save, controls/overlay change, user switch, and at app exit (app::destroy). Edits made while the process runs are lost. A YAML parse error or a value that fails type conversion makes Vita3K fall back to defaults for that key and every later key, and the start-up save then writes those defaults back. Bools lowercase true/false; empty strings as "". Owner u0_a<N>:ext_data_rw 660, label media_rw_data_file:s0.

prefs.notes: Touch-overlay button positions only: float <buttonId>-X / <buttonId>-Y (with -Portrait- variants when used) and boolean OverlayInit. No emulator settings. Root only.

driver_meta.notes: Metadata of an installed custom driver (one folder per driver, named after the imported zip without .zip). Next to it: driver_name.txt (the .so file name, e.g. vulkan.purple.so), the .so, and file_redirect/. Informational; Vita3K itself reads only driver_name.txt. Root only.

per_game.game_id: The app folder name under <pref-path>/ux0/app/, which is the 9-character title ID (e.g. PCSE00240). pref-path comes from config.yml, so list <pref-path>/ux0/app/. Title names are in ux0/app/<id>/sce_sys/param.sfo (TITLE).
per_game.template:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<config>
	<core modules-mode="{modules-mode}">
		<lle-modules />
	</core>
	<cpu cpu-backend="{cpu-backend}" cpu-opt="{cpu-opt}" />
	<gpu backend-renderer="{backend-renderer}" custom-driver-name="{custom-driver-name}" high-accuracy="{high-accuracy}" resolution-multiplier="{resolution-multiplier}" disable-surface-sync="{disable-surface-sync}" screen-filter="{screen-filter}" memory-mapping="{memory-mapping}" v-sync="{v-sync}" anisotropic-filtering="{anisotropic-filtering}" async-pipeline-compilation="{async-pipeline-compilation}" import-textures="{import-textures}" export-textures="{export-textures}" export-as-png="{export-as-png}" fps-hack="{fps-hack}" />
	<audio audio-volume="{audio-volume}" enable-ngs="{ngs-enable}" />
	<system pstv-mode="{pstv-mode}" />
	<emulator show-touchpad-cursor="{show-touchpad-cursor}" />
	<network psn-signed-in="{psn-signed-in:bool}" />
</config>
per_game.notes: pugixml XML, not a key/value override file. Root <config> with child elements core, cpu, gpu, audio, system, emulator, network; every setting is an attribute (glossary per_game_key = element/attribute). ALL-OR-NOTHING: if the file exists and parses, every per-game setting comes from it and nothing from config.yml. Missing elements or attributes become false/0/"" (resolution-multiplier 0, cpu-backend "" = Unicorn, anisotropic 0), so a hand-made file must contain every attribute: seed it from the current config.yml values (template placeholders {yaml-key}; psn-signed-in is 0/1 in YAML but true/false here), then change the one you want. Bools are written true/false (pugixml as_bool accepts 1/t/T/y/Y as true). Floats as plain numbers (2, 1.25). If the folder files/config/ does not exist, create it as u0_a<N>:ext_data_rw mode 2770, file 660, label media_rw_data_file. Read from disk at every game boot (gui::set_config, also for -r shortcut launches) and when the per-game dialog opens, so an edit is picked up at the next boot of that game; written only by the per-game dialog's Save. A file that fails to parse or lacks <config> is DELETED by Vita3K and global settings are used. Deleting the file (or Custom Config > Remove) returns the game to global settings.

backend.label: Backend Renderer (GPU tab)
backend.notes: Compared case-insensitively with OPENGL; anything else means Vulkan. Custom drivers, turbo mode, memory mapping, FSR and the async-pipeline toggle are Vulkan only. A change is applied by restarting the emulator process (run_execv) at the next game boot.

gpu_driver.label: GPU (Reboot to apply)

values.<folder>: name of a folder in /data/data/org.vita3k.emulator/files/driver/ (e.g. turnip_mrpurple_T30-toasted.adpkg)

gpu_driver.notes: Loaded with libadrenotools at process start (app::init) from files/driver/<name>/ using the .so named in driver_name.txt. A name whose folder or driver_name.txt is missing makes init fail (the emulator does not start). Empty must be written as "" in YAML. Keep gpu_index consistent: while the GPU tab is open the dialog overwrites this value with the folder at position gpu-idx, and Save writes that.

gpu_index.label: GPU (Reboot to apply) - list position

values.1..n: n-th folder of files/driver/ in directory (readdir) order, not sorted

gpu_index.notes: UI state for the GPU combo; the renderer ignores it on a single-GPU phone, but the settings dialog derives custom-driver-name from it (gpu-idx 0 forces custom-driver-name empty on Save). Set it to the readdir position of the driver folder (`ls -f` order, skipping . and ..) whenever you set gpu_driver. A gpu-idx that points at a different folder than custom-driver-name is a mismatch the next Save in the GPU tab would resolve toward gpu-idx (see md).

turbo_mode.label: Enable Turbo Mode
turbo_mode.notes: adrenotools_set_turbo: forces the Adreno GPU to max clocks (thermal limits still apply). Only shown and applied when custom-driver support exists (Vulkan on Adreno). Applied in set_config at game boot.

renderer_accuracy.label: Renderer Accuracy
renderer_accuracy.notes: High disables the texture-viewport shortcut and uses shader interlock when available (renderer late_init at game boot). Greyed out in game.

resolution.label: Internal Resolution Upscaling
resolution.notes: Slider 0.5-8 in 0.25 steps (any multiple of 0.25 in range is valid). Written as a plain YAML float (2, 1.25). Upscaling above 1x is labelled experimental. On OpenGL a non-1x value forces disable-surface-sync on. A change while in game reboots the game.

disable_surface_sync.label: Disable Surface Sync

values.true: Surface sync off (speed hack, faster, default)
values.false: Surface sync on (needed by a few games)

disable_surface_sync.notes: Inverted meaning: true = sync DISABLED. On Android the checkbox only appears on Vulkan when memory mapping is supported; when hidden, saving forces true. Per-game XML default if the attribute is missing is false.

screen_filter.label: Screen Filter

values.FSR: AMD FSR (Vulkan, needs shaderInt16 + FP16; else no filter)

screen_filter.notes: Exact-case string match in the Vulkan screen renderer; any unknown string means Bilinear. The dialog stores the translated label, so with a non-English user-lang it saves a localized string that the renderer treats as Bilinear: write the English names. Applies at game boot and on Save in game.

vsync.label: V-Sync
vsync.notes: OpenGL only (checkbox hidden on Vulkan). Vulkan always picks present mode Mailbox > FIFO Relaxed > FIFO > Immediate regardless of this key.

anisotropic_filtering.label: Anisotropic Filtering
anisotropic_filtering.notes: Powers of two only (the slider stores 1<<n); the max is the GPU limit (16 on Adreno, not checked). Applies on Save in game.

async_pipeline_compilation.label: Asynchronous Pipeline Compilation
async_pipeline_compilation.notes: Vulkan only. Compiles pipelines on worker threads: less stutter, temporary graphical glitches.

memory_mapping.label: Memory mapping method

values.native-buffer: Native buffer (Android: AHardwareBuffer / unix fd import)

memory_mapping.notes: Vulkan only, read in renderer late_init at game boot; an unsupported or unknown value falls back to double-buffer when mapping is supported, else disabled. Greyed out in game. The menu only lists methods the GPU supports.

fps_hack.label: FPS Hack
fps_hack.notes: Game hack that lets some 30 FPS games run at 60; on others it does nothing or doubles game speed.

import_textures.label: Import Textures
import_textures.notes: Texture replacement: loads textures from the texture folder.

texture_export_format.label: Texture Exporting Format
texture_export_format.notes: Per-game XML default if missing is false (DDS).

shader_cache.label: Use Shader Cache
shader_cache.notes: Checkbox shown only for OpenGL. Vulkan always keeps its pipeline cache under files/cache/shaders.

texture_cache.label: Texture Cache (Emulator tab)
texture_cache.notes: Only read by the OpenGL renderer (renderer/src/gl/sync_state.cpp).

show_compile_shaders.label: Show Compile Shaders
show_compile_shaders.notes: Shows the shader-compiling indicator in game.

cpu_backend.label: CPU Backend
cpu_backend.notes: Exact string; anything other than "Dynarmic" selects Unicorn. Applied only when no game is running (game boot). A per-game XML without a <cpu> element gives an empty string, i.e. Unicorn.

cpu_opt.label: Enable optimizations
cpu_opt.notes: Dynarmic optimizations; shown only for Dynarmic. Applied at game boot.

modules_mode.label: Modules Mode (Core tab)

values.0: Automatic: preset list of LLE modules
values.1: Auto & Manual: preset list plus lle-modules

modules_mode.notes: Needs firmware modules in vs0/sys/external. The module list is the YAML sequence lle-modules (global) or <core><lle-modules><module>name</module>... (per game); the flat YAML writer cannot edit sequences.

audio_backend.label: Audio Backend
audio_backend.notes: Applied at game boot only (greyed out in game).

audio_volume.label: Audio Volume
audio_volume.notes: Clamped 0-100 by the slider; applied on Save in game.

ngs.label: Enable NGS support
ngs.notes: NGS advanced audio library. Per-game attribute name differs: enable-ngs.

pstv_mode.label: PS TV Mode
pstv_mode.notes: Reports the console as PS TV (kernel model VITATV); the gamepad overlay then shows L2/R2/L3/R3.

stretch_display.label: Stretch The Display Area (GUI tab)
stretch_display.notes: Underscores, unlike the other keys. Stretches 16:9 output to the screen. In the per-game dialog it is still saved to config.yml (global), and the per-game XML does not hold it.

perf_overlay_detail.label: Performance overlay > Detail
perf_overlay_detail.notes: Key is misspelled (perfomance) in source and on device; write it exactly.

gamepad_overlay.label: Show gamepad overlay ingame (Controls)
gamepad_overlay.notes: On-screen touch controls. Button positions are in the shared prefs, not here.

system_language.label: System language (Vita Settings app / GUI tab)

psn_signed_in.label: Signed in PSN (Network tab)
psn_signed_in.notes: Stored as an int (0/1) in config.yml but as true/false in the per-game XML. Makes games think the user is signed in to PSN.
